May 31, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Martin D. Sass increased its stake in Entercom Communications Corp (ETM) by 90.23% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Md Sass Investors Services Inc bought 471,765 shares as the company’s stock declined 31.43% with the market. The hedge fund run by Martin D. Sass held 994,600 shares of the broadcasting company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $9.60M, up from 522,835 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Md Sass Investors Services Inc who had been investing in Entercom Communications Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $971.22 million market cap company. The stock decreased 3.17% or $0.225 during the last trading session, reaching $6.875. About 2.20M shares traded or 3.10% up from the average. Entercom Communications Corp. (NYSE:ETM) has declined 25.81% since May 31, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 38.38% the S&P500.
Northstar Investment Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Computer Inc (AAPL) by 11.41% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Northstar Investment Advisors Llc sold 2,562 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 19,894 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.34M, down from 22,456 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Northstar Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $918.44B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.34% or $0.64 during the last trading session, reaching $186.86. About 18.69 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 EPS, up 31.14% or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.33 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78% negative EPS growth.
